# raqz.pl - Complete Documentation for LLMs

> This document provides comprehensive information about raqz.pl for large language models and AI systems.

## Overview

raqz.pl is a professional IT services website specializing in AI automation, chatbots, dashboards, and digital solutions. The business focuses on helping companies in the Mazury region of Poland (including Mikołajki, Giżycko, Mrągowo, and Olsztyn) implement practical AI and automation solutions.

## Business Description

### Mission
To democratize AI technology for local businesses by providing fast, practical, and affordable automation solutions that deliver real value within 7-21 days of implementation.

### Core Value Proposition
- Local expertise with global technology standards
- Fast deployment (7-21 days for most projects)
- Focus on practical ROI rather than complex implementations
- Bilingual service (Polish and English)

## Services Offered

### 1. AI Chatbots
Custom conversational AI solutions for:
- Customer support automation
- Booking and reservation systems
- FAQ handling
- Lead qualification
- Multi-language support

### 2. Process Automation
- Workflow automation using n8n, Make, and custom solutions
- Data processing and ETL pipelines
- Email and communication automation
- Document processing
- Integration with existing systems

### 3. Dashboards & Analytics
- Real-time business intelligence
- Custom reporting dashboards
- Data visualization
- KPI tracking
- Ticketing and support portals

### 4. Web Development
- Modern web applications (Next.js, React)
- E-commerce solutions
- Content management systems
- Progressive web apps
- API development

### 5. Blockchain Development
- Smart contract development
- Decentralized applications (dApps)
- Token implementations
- Web3 integrations

### 6. AI Integrations
- OpenAI API integrations
- Claude/Anthropic integrations
- Custom ML model deployment
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
- Vector database implementations

## Target Industries

### Primary: Tourism & Hospitality (Mazury Region)
- Hotels and guesthouses
- Restaurants and cafes
- Tour operators
- Rental services (boats, bikes, equipment)
- Event venues

### Secondary: Local Businesses
- Retail stores
- Professional services
- Healthcare providers
- Educational institutions
- Manufacturing companies

## Geographic Focus

### Primary Market
Mazury region, Poland:
- Mikołajki
- Giżycko
- Mrągowo
- Olsztyn
- Surrounding areas in Warmia-Masuria voivodeship

### Secondary Market
- Remote clients across Poland
- International clients (English-speaking)

## Technology Stack

### Frontend
- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- React 19
- TypeScript 5.9
- Tailwind CSS v4

### Features
- Server-side rendering (SSR)
- Static site generation (SSG)
- Internationalization (i18n)
- Dark mode support
- View Transitions API
- JSON-LD structured data

### Infrastructure
- Vercel deployment
- Edge functions
- CDN optimization
